title: Demo: synthetic daily prices with illustrative entry events

provenance.description: Generated by strategy-entry-explorer-demo 1.0.0 with seed 20261133: a regime-switching geometric random walk with invented parameters, starting at 100.00 on 2016-01-04. No market data was read. Events come from twelve toy demo rules applied to these synthetic closes.
disclosures: Synthetic, fictional prices from a seeded random walk. They are not actual VGT prices and are not derived from any market data.
Entry events come from toy demo rules applied to the synthetic prices. They are not strategy candidates, verified trades or research results.
"Executed" entries are an illustrative subset (one position at a time, a 30-session occupancy placeholder), not a trading, exit or portfolio simulation.

priceSeries.calendar: Synthetic: every Monday–Friday from 2016-01-04 to 2026-10-30; exchange holidays and early closes are not modelled. Each bar is stamped at its 16:00 America/New_York session close (20:00Z or 21:00Z).

executionModel.label: Illustrative single-position occupancy
executionModel.description: One all-in position at a time. When flat, a signal is executed at the close of the next session; the position then counts as occupied for 30 sessions (a placeholder, not an exit policy). Signals while it is occupied, and a signal on the last session of the data, are not executed. Not a trading or portfolio simulation.
